Question: Define a function on the positive integers recursively by \(f(1)=2,\) \(f(n)=f(n-1)+1\) if \(n\) is even, and \(f(n)=f(n-2)+2\) if \(n\) is odd and greater than \(1.\) What is \(f(2017)?\)
